facts.summary: Phase 2 missed statistical significance on primary cognitive endpoint, only nominal trends · Phase 2 · CT1812 in mild-to-moderate Alzheimer's · not yet approved

evidence.summary: Consistent efficacy signal: favorable, non-statistically significant treatment differences v. placebo with both dose groups across all key outcome measures
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: Because p>0.05 for first test (pooled 100+300mg vs. pbo), formal testing stopped, and all p-values are considered nominal.
evidence.safety: CT1812 demonstrated favorable safety and tolerability profile
